evaluationPolicy: All learned adapters are trained only on each 5-fold training split (32 queries) and evaluated on the disjoint fold (8 queries). No original benchmark checkpoint is reported as an AX result.

masRouterAdapted.paper: MasRouter: Learning to Route LLMs for Multi-Agent Systems, ACL 2025
masRouterAdapted.axMapping: NumDeterminer is mapped to training-neighbor agent-count prediction; RoleAllocation is mapped to sequential role selection using query-role similarity and learned role co-occurrence history.
deviations: The official VAE/RL controller is not trained because the AX set has only 32 training queries per fold.
Collaboration topology and LLM-brand routing are held constant so that only expert-role selection is compared.
This is an architecture-preserving AX adapter, not the original checkpoint result.

routeLlmMfAdapted.paper: RouteLLM: Learning to Route LLMs with Preference Data, 2024
routeLlmMfAdapted.axMapping: Candidate LLM embeddings are replaced by expert-role embeddings. Positive roles are preferred over negative roles for each query and trained with pairwise logistic matrix-factorization loss; thresholds are calibrated inside each training fold.
deviations: Hashed Korean query features replace OpenAI text-embedding-3-small to keep the comparison local and reproducible.
The task is multilabel expert selection rather than strong-versus-weak LLM selection.
This is a preference-MF AX adapter, not a claim of reproducing RouteLLM benchmark scores.

irtRouterAdapted.paper: IRT-Router: Effective and Interpretable Multi-LLM Routing via Item Response Theory, ACL 2025
irtRouterAdapted.axMapping: LLM ability parameters are mapped to expert-role ability vectors. Query features generate item discrimination and difficulty, and binary role relevance is learned through a multidimensional 2PL objective.
deviations: Hashed Korean features replace BERT embeddings.
The upstream LFS evaluation data was unavailable because the repository LFS budget was exceeded.
This is a MIRT-structured AX adapter, not the original 20-LLM/12-dataset reproduction.
